title: Python
description: Register a Web App and set a strong FLASK_SECRET_KEY plus the SSO environment variables. Use authorize_redirect() in the login route and authorize_access_token() in the callback; Authlib handles state, nonce and ID-token validation.
code:
import os
from flask import Flask
from authlib.integrations.flask_client import OAuth

app = Flask(__name__)
app.secret_key = os.environ['FLASK_SECRET_KEY']
oauth = OAuth(app)

oauth.register(
    name='sso',
    client_id=os.environ['SSO_CLIENT_ID'],
    client_secret=os.environ['SSO_CLIENT_SECRET'],
    server_metadata_url=(
        os.environ['SSO_ISSUER'].rstrip('/')
        + '/.well-known/openid-configuration'
    ),
    client_kwargs={
        'scope': 'openid profile email',
        'code_challenge_method': 'S256',
    },
)
